title: 第25章 婢女第26章 他念
lines: 雨还在下。
身为圣地的圣女，画心还保留着仅存的骄傲。
她是传承到今的圣女，也是圣地最后的荣耀。
圣地千年前就衰落了。
她没有见过圣地那荣耀的时候，但是她很憧憬。
画心时时刻刻铭记着圣女的传承，她很想光复圣地的荣耀，虽然知道那根本不现实。
而她也变成了一个吉祥物般的女子，将来要嫁给天剑盟的少盟主。
画心不喜欢他，那少盟主完完全全是纨绔子弟，玩弄女修，不学无术，他的名声早就在外了。
但是画心却身不由己。
圣地如今还能存在，不被抹去，也依仗着天剑盟的余威。
画心知道天剑盟想要什么，他想要圣地的传承！
毕竟圣地的功法只有血脉传承才能修行。
自己到时候嫁给天剑盟少盟主后，有了血脉，那圣地的所有一切都会归天剑盟！
而天剑盟也会成为中州下一个圣地。
而自己如果拒绝，那圣地马上就会被抹平，一切都不存在。
只不过温水煮青蛙而已，这些画心明白，画心的师父也明白，但是却无可奈何。
但是一个消息的出现，令画心为之一震！
销声匿迹一千多年的珍宝阁出现了！
画心并没有见过珍宝阁，但是圣地留下的书籍中却记载了大量与珍宝阁有关的线索！
而且圣地的崛起也离不开珍宝阁！
而画心也发现，自己的师父的眼中也出现了久违的光芒。
只是那光芒被刻意隐藏着。
中州所有人都激动万分！
而接下来几天传来的消息更令人吃惊！
珍宝阁不出手则已，一出手就一鸣惊人！
九品神果翠果被人得到，而真正令画心前来的还是珍宝阁主再次消失，而这次却走出来一位大师兄！
而且甚至把那位得到翠果的修士也收入珍宝阁！
这是从来没有过的的事情！
从来没有，就要连中州圣地留下的书籍中都从来没有记载过！
画心明白这是一个机会，一个可以令圣地再次崛起的机会！
紧接着珍宝阁再次拿出了一枚珍宝，而且甚至是九品神果的种子！
只是用来换取珍宝山上的一栋建筑！
画心知道这不简单！
她在这三天没日没夜的翻看古籍，终于，他在中州圣地留下的书籍中看到了一副插画。
一副有些模糊的插画，一座不高的山顶上，宽阔平整的大路，而路的尽头是一片建筑，那些建筑看起来朴素无华，但是却鳞次栉比，错落有致，形成了一个独特的商业圈，而画的尽头却是一间不起眼的小院。
画心看到这这幅画的时候一愣，画上没有任何名称线索，但是画心却觉得心跳加快！
这好像就是曾经的珍宝阁！
激动万分的画心赶忙做出了方案，她要见见那珍宝阁大师兄！
她要脱颖而出！
但是为的却不是那九品神果。
雨浸透了她的衣服，就连头上戴的薄纱都把头发染湿，而这雨却没有半分停下的意思，反而越来越大。
自己见到了那珍宝阁的大师兄，可是当自己提出要去以后，那大师兄转头就走，没有留下半句话。
依旧跪在山脚，依旧跪在雨中，画心没有半分动摇，这是她最后的机会了。
山脚下的人都走光了，看着跪在雨中的自己，有的是惋惜的摇头，而有的却怪自己坏了好事。
content_en:
It's still raining.
As a saint in the Holy Land, Hua Xin still retains her remaining pride.
She is a saint who has been passed down to this day, and she is also the last glory of the Holy Land.
The Holy Land fell into decline thousands of years ago.
She had never seen the glory of the Holy Land, but she longed for it.
Hua Xin always remembers the inheritance of the Saint. She wants to restore the glory of the Holy Land, although she knows that is not realistic at all.
And she also turned into a mascot-like woman who would marry the young leader of the Heavenly Sword Alliance in the future.
Hua Xin didn't like him. The young alliance leader was a complete playboy, playing tricks on female cultivators, and was uneducated and incompetent. His reputation had long been spread outside.
But Hua Xin couldn't help herself.
The Holy Land can still exist today and will not be erased, relying on the remaining power of the Heavenly Sword Alliance.
Hua Xin knew what the Heavenly Sword Alliance wanted, he wanted the inheritance of the Holy Land!
After all, the techniques in the Holy Land can only be practiced through blood inheritance.
After I marry the young leader of the Heavenly Sword Alliance and have a bloodline, everything in the Holy Land will belong to the Heavenly Sword Alliance!
And the Heavenly Sword Alliance will also become the next holy land in Zhongzhou.
And if he refuses, the holy land will be wiped out immediately and everything will cease to exist.
It's just a frog boiled in warm water. These painting minds understand it, and the master who paints the mind also understands it, but there is nothing they can do about it.
But the emergence of a piece of news shocked Hua's heart!
The Treasure Pavilion, which has been missing for more than a thousand years, appears!
Hua Xin has never seen the Treasure Pavilion, but the books left behind in the Holy Land contain a large number of clues related to the Treasure Pavilion!
And the rise of the Holy Land is inseparable from the Treasure Pavilion!
Hua Xin also discovered that a long-lost light appeared in his master's eyes.
But that light was deliberately hidden.
Everyone in Zhongzhou is extremely excited!
And the news that came in the next few days was even more surprising!
Zhenbao Pavilion is fine if you don't take action, but if you take action, it will become a blockbuster!
The Ninth Grade Divine Fruit Green Fruit was obtained, but what really made Hua Xin come here was that the Master of the Treasure Pavilion disappeared again, but this time a senior brother came out!
And even the monk who got the green fruit was included in the Treasure Pavilion!
This has never happened before!
Never, not even in the books left behind by Zhongzhou Holy Land!
Hua Xin understood that this was an opportunity, an opportunity to make the Holy Land rise again!
Immediately afterwards, the Treasure Pavilion took out a treasure again, and it was even the seed of the ninth-grade divine fruit!
It’s just used in exchange for a building on Treasure Mountain!
Hua Xin knows this is not easy!
She had been looking through ancient books day and night for the past three days, and finally she saw an illustration in the book left in Zhongzhou Holy Land.
A somewhat vague illustration, on the top of a low mountain, there is a broad and flat road, and at the end of the road is a building. The buildings look simple and unpretentious, but they are lined up in rows and scattered, forming a unique business circle. At the end of the painting is an inconspicuous small courtyard.
Hua Xin was stunned when she saw this painting. There was no clue about the name of the painting, but Hua Xin felt her heart beat faster!
This seems to be the former Treasure Pavilion!
The extremely excited Hua Xin quickly made a plan. She wanted to meet the senior brother of Zhenbao Pavilion!
She wants to stand out!
But it's not for the ninth-grade divine fruit.
The rain soaked through her clothes, and even the tulle on her head dyed her hair wet. However, the rain did not show any intention of stopping, but became heavier and heavier.
I met the senior brother of Zhenbao Pavilion, but when I asked to go, the senior brother turned around and left without leaving a word.
Still kneeling at the foot of the mountain, still kneeling in the rain, her heart has not wavered in the slightest. This is her last chance.
All the people at the foot of the mountain were gone. Looking at themselves kneeling in the rain, some shook their heads with regret, while others blamed themselves for ruining a good thing.
